sources.excerpt: --> Mid-Fi Electronics ::: Full Frequency Overdrive HOME PEDALS PURCHASE Full Frequency Overdrive Never thought I’d have to design an “uncompressed” “transparent” overdrive. But I honestly couldn’t find a pedal that sounded how a thought something like that would sound. So, for better or worse, here it is! Great anywhere in your effects chain, and won't gobble up all the level of that super loud fuzz pedal you placed before it.
